guesses.reason: The solid white, medium-length plush coat, dark eye rims, and sturdy large-breed puppy build strongly suggest a white livestock guardian breed.
The broad head, soft folded ears, friendly open-mouthed expression, and shorter, smoother face coat resemble a cream or white Lab.
The semi-erect, folding ears with slight lift at the base and a slightly longer muzzle hint at shepherd ancestry.

breed.appearance: Vera is a young, large-breed puppy with a solid creamy-white, soft, medium-short double coat that looks plush on the chest and a fluffy tail curled to one side. She has a broad head with floppy, triangular ears that fold forward at the tips, warm almond-shaped dark brown eyes, and a dusky brownish-black nose. Her muzzle is medium length, her pink tongue peeks out in a happy grin, and she sits upright on sturdy legs wearing a green collar clipped to an orange leash.
breed.fun_fact: Great Pyrenees are gentle giants famous for watching over their flocks, so Vera may grow up to be your family's loyal, cuddly guardian!
